resolution.question: Will Ashvale University's academic senate pass, reject, or send back to committee the pass-fail grading motion at its October plenary?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the academic senate voted to pass the motion at the October plenary (by 2026-10-15T23:59:59-05:00). Resolve NO if the senate voted to reject the motion. Resolve SEND_BACK if the senate voted to send the motion back to committee. If no vote occurs by the end of the plenary, resolve NO.
